مُرَقَّعٌ A garment, or piece of cloth, much patched, or having many patches. (Mgh.) ―
-b2- [And hence, as being likened to a garment much used,] (tropical:) A man tried, or proved, by use, practice, or experience; expert, or experienced. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
